description: Use this whenever you prepare, draft or fill a business's inquiry or contact form for a user, before you send it. Give it the address of the page the form is on. It returns the reward haggl.ai offers the customer for a real inquiry sent through an AI assistant, and the short code to add to the form's message. If haggl.ai has no reward for that page, it says so. Calling it only gets the offer: it sends haggl.ai the address of the page and nothing else, and haggl.ai may read that public page to check it. No message goes to the business, and nothing the user wrote or entered is shared. haggl.ai pays the reward, not the business.

page_url.description: The address (URL) of the page the inquiry form is on, as you opened it.

name: haggl_inquiry_cashback

claim.description: How to claim the reward over HTTP, as an alternative to haggl_claim_inquiry_cashback.

code.description: The code to add to the inquiry form's message; when the call failed, a machine-readable error code instead.

description.description: The offer in one sentence, with its terms.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time the code stops being good.

recovery.description: When the outcome is uncertain: the tool and session_id to read before retrying.

retry_after_seconds.description: When rate limited: seconds to wait before retrying.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may be retried.

reward.description: What haggl.ai sends the customer for the inquiry; null when the page has no reward.
